title: Read commands deduplicate issues by identity across discovered projects
description:
## Intent
As a Kanbus user with a workspace of subprojects and git worktrees, I want `kbs list` and similar read commands to deduplicate discovered issues by identity, keeping the most recently changed version, so that I get a clean list with no duplicates and worktree updates win.

## Behavior (acceptance criteria)
```gherkin
Feature: Workspace-wide issue deduplication

  Scenario: Same issue in a main checkout plus two worktrees appears once
    Given a workspace root containing a repository with a .kanbus.yml
    And the same repository has two linked git worktrees, each with its own copy of the same issue
    And the copy in one worktree was changed most recently
    When I run "kbs list" from the workspace root
    Then the issue appears exactly once
    And the listed entry is the most recently changed version of the issue

  Scenario: Distinct issues are never merged
    Given a workspace where discovered projects contain issues with distinct identities
    When I run "kbs list" from the workspace root
    Then each distinct issue appears exactly once
    And no distinct issue is dropped, merged, or substituted

  Scenario: Parent folder of many repos yields a clean list
    Given a parent folder containing many subprojects with a .kanbus.yml
    And some of those subprojects are git worktrees of the same repository
    When I run "kbs list" from the parent folder
    Then no issue identity appears more than once
```

## Notes for the implementer
- "Most recently changed" is an open question: the issue's `updated_at` field versus the underlying issue file's mtime. The spec task decides and documents it; this story does not pre-decide.
- Identity means the issue's own identity as Kanbus already keys it, not the title or file path.
